howe_sound.label: Howe Sound
howe_sound.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 09:30 PM PDT 13 August 2026 Tonight and Friday. Wind light becoming northerly outflow 5 to 15 knots late overnight then becoming southerly inflow 5 to 15 near noon Friday except southwesterly inflow 15 to 20 over northern sections. Wind becoming light Friday evening. Showers with a risk of thunderstorms tonight and Friday afternoon. <h2 class="h3 mrgn-tp-0"

strait_of_georgia_south.label: Strait of Georgia (south of Nanaimo)
strait_of_georgia_south.text: >Marine Forecast Issued 09:30 PM PDT 13 August 2026 Tonight and Friday. Wind southeast 5 to 15 knots becoming light late Friday afternoon. Scattered showers overnight and Friday morning with a risk of thunderstorms. <h2 class="h3 mrgn-tp-0"

Classic Squamish summer thermal: valley heats, draws air up Howe Sound from the south. Multiple models agree, which is a good sign for a thermal-driven day. Field-calibrated: raw coarse-model wind (~3kt) is scaled up ~2.85x, matching how this thermal typically under-reads on GFS-class models (source: local rider calibration, see README). Caution: MSLP doesn't clearly support inflow yet (large-scale 0.0hPa, local 0.8hPa) — could be weaker or more marginal than the wind signal alone suggests.
